data.title: 矢来美羽 · 路线图上的标记
data.description: 出发前，美羽把路线图摊在桌上，用铅笔圈出需要查看的路口。
data.action: marking a street map with a pencil
data.promptProse: At a wooden security office table covered in regional patrol diagrams, Miu uses a red highlighter marker to trace an intersection checkpoint, checking her pocket watch to confirm patrol schedules. Warm desk lamp light illuminates clipped security badges, incident files, and her serious, dependable dedication to guarding the town.
